title: ID0389662-DC/Si-D/NL[R7VjM6] - Tripline query
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Is the tripline from the ELMS system mandatory?
Root cause:
N/A
Solution:
The main function of the trip line is to put the charger in the emergency (deactivated) state in case the charger is not able to maintain the total active power consumption below the power limit setpoint sent by ELMS for a certain time.
As such, you only need to implement it in case this is occurs.
